prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     If object approached, take it, check properties and move to destination, then do specific task. If not visible, approach or scan.     list of available nodes: <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    />  <Action ID = MoveToDestination    />  <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    />  <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />  <Action ID = ApproachObject    />  <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectProperties
		DO MoveToDestination
		DO SpecificTask
	END
